title: Lesson 2 - What Have You Been Up To?

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Thanks for getting back to me. It's nice to have more than five minutes this time.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Definitely. We can finally catch up. What have you been up to since I left Riverton?

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Quite a lot. I've changed roles at the hospital, as you know, and I've taken a few short training courses.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: When did you take the most recent one?

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Three months ago. It was a three-day course for hospital trainers.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: How did that go?

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Really well. I met trainers from five other hospitals and came home with too many ideas.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: That sounds like you.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Maybe. Are you still getting used to working from home?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Not really. I've worked remotely on lots of different projects.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: When did you start?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: About two years ago, right after I left my old job.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: What about Seattle? Have you been back since you moved back?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Not yet. I still have friends there, but I don't miss the traffic. I don't commute anymore.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: That's a big change.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: It is. And I've taken more pictures since I moved back.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Really? What have you photographed?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Mostly places that have changed. Last Sunday, I photographed part of the old bookstore sign behind Corner Table.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: I didn't know any of it was still there.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Only a small part. Here—it's on my phone.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Oh, I like it. Have you ever thought about making this a project?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Not until now.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: What made you start taking these pictures?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Moving back. I used to walk past these places without thinking. Now I notice what's different.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Well, I'm glad we finally did this.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Me too. Eight years is a lot to fit into one lunch.
